findings.summary: Orchestration does not short-circuit write steps on branch-occupancy refusal. harvest.py:613-641 (pr_merge) sets only pr_merged=false/pr_url='' when pr_squash_merge returns {refused:true, escalate:HARVEST_BRANCH_OCCUPIED}, and never sets outcome=escalated or writes_skipped; harvest.py:918 is an unconditional pr_merge→pull edge with no after_pr_merge conditional. The graph therefore still runs ff_only_pull, deploy and verify_real against the canonical checkout before postconditions escalates, violating spec 交付 A.2 ('编排层据此 outcome=escalated，走既有 escalate 收尾，不触碰任何写步').
